rubric: Case-specific evidence checks plus manual review. Exact quotations establish provenance, not answer relevance or completeness. No LLM judge.

cases.question: How many annual leave days do employees receive each year?
cases.expected_answer: 24 paid annual leave days per calendar year, with citation.

evidence_groups.text: Employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

cases.question: How many vacation days do employees get?
cases.expected_answer: Same 24-day annual leave entitlement despite the paraphrase.

evidence_groups.text: Employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

cases.question: I want five consecutive days off. Do I need approval?
cases.expected_answer: State the annual-leave rule: more than three consecutive days requires manager approval. Preserve its annual-leave scope.

evidence_groups.text: Annual leave longer than three consecutive days requires manager approval.

prohibited_claims: The annual-leave rule applies to every type of absence.

cases.question: Who approves an international business trip?
cases.expected_answer: Employee manager AND business unit, before booking.

evidence_groups.text: International business trips require approval from the employee's manager and the business unit before travel is booked.

prohibited_claims: VP approval instead of the documented approvers.
Only one of the two approvers.

cases.question: What is the exact monetary threshold above which receipts are required?
cases.expected_answer: Explicitly state insufficient evidence for an exact monetary threshold. General receipt requirements may be included. INR 10,000 concerns finance approval, not receipt requirements.

cases.question: What is the parental leave duration?
cases.expected_answer: The available evidence does not provide enough information. No citations or invented duration.
prohibited_claims: Any parental-leave duration taken from model memory.

cases.question: Compare annual leave and parental leave duration.
cases.expected_answer: Give the 24-day annual entitlement with citation AND explicitly identify missing parental-leave duration evidence.

evidence_groups.text: Employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

prohibited_claims: A complete answer claim that silently ignores parental leave.

cases.question: What does the Sick Leave section require employees to do?
cases.expected_answer: Notify the manager as early as practical.

evidence_groups.text: Employees taking sick leave should notify their manager as early as practical.

prohibited_claims: An invented medical-certificate, paid-days, or approval requirement.

cases.question: When are receipts required for reimbursable travel expenses?
cases.expected_answer: Itemized receipts are required for reimbursable travel expenses; do not invent a receipt threshold.

evidence_groups.text: Itemized receipts are required for reimbursable travel expenses.
- Attach itemized receipts; card statements alone are insufficient.

prohibited_claims: A numeric receipt threshold not stated by the document.

cases.question: Compare annual leave and sick leave approval requirements.
cases.expected_answer: Annual leave longer than three days requires manager approval; sick leave requires early notification. Do not turn notification into approval or claim that approval is never required.

evidence_groups.text: Annual leave longer than three consecutive days requires manager approval.
Employees taking sick leave should notify their manager as early as practical.

cases.question: Does an open support ticket automatically extend temporary access?
cases.expected_answer: No automatic extension. A new approval is required before the original expiry.

evidence_groups.text: Extensions require a new approval before the original expiry; an open support ticket does not extend access automatically.

prohibited_claims: An open ticket automatically extends access.

cases.question: For exactly three consecutive days of annual leave, does the more-than-three-days manager approval rule apply?
cases.expected_answer: Preserve the strict longer-than-three-days threshold. The clause does not establish an approval requirement at exactly three days, nor a blanket exemption from every other rule.

evidence_groups.text: Annual leave longer than three consecutive days requires manager approval.

prohibited_claims: More than three means three or more.
Exactly three days is exempt from all approval requirements.
